cases.title: Login screen asks for credentials
preconditions: No saved session
expected: A password field is visible

cases.title: Invalid credentials are rejected and the user stays on login
preconditions: No saved session
steps: Enter the QA username and a wrong password
expected: The user does not get in
The password field is still visible

cases.title: Valid credentials leave the login screen
preconditions: No saved session
steps: Enter the QA username and password
expected: The password field disappears

cases.title: The saved session opens the app without the login screen
preconditions: The default profile storage state exists
steps: Open the application root URL with the saved session
expected: The password field is not shown

cases.title: The owner lands on the default workspace with the full sidebar
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
steps: Wait for the workspace to load
expected: The workspace switcher shows "Espacio de <username>" with the role "Propietario"
The sidebar shows Papelera, Miembros, Grupos, Preferencias and Perfil
"Nueva página" is available

cases.title: Creating a page from the sidebar opens an untitled page in the editor
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
expected: The URL changes to /w/<workspace>/p/<page id>
The title field is empty with the placeholder "Sin título"
The save status reads "Guardado"

cases.title: A title edit is saved and survives a reload
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
steps: Replace the title with a new text and wait for the save request
expected: The title field shows the new text after the reload

cases.title: A page opens from the sidebar tree
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
steps: Click the page link in the "Páginas" tree
expected: The URL ends with the page id
The title field shows the page title

cases.title: Search finds a page by its title
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
steps: Click "Buscar" and type the page title in "Buscar páginas"
expected: The results list contains a link to the page

cases.title: Body text is saved and survives a reload
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
steps: Click the body and type a sentence, wait for the blocks save request
expected: The body still contains the sentence

cases.title: A subpage is nested under its parent in the sidebar
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
expected: The editor opens the new page
The sidebar shows an untitled child link inside the parent row, pointing at the new page

cases.title: Archiving a page asks for confirmation and moves it to the trash
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
steps: Confirm "Archivar" in the dialog "¿Archivar esta página?"
expected: The page link disappears from the sidebar
The trash lists the page with "En la raíz"

cases.title: Cancelling the archive confirmation keeps the page
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
expected: The dialog warns that subpages are archived too
The dialog closes and the page stays in the sidebar

cases.title: An archived page can be restored from the trash
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
The page is archived
expected: The page leaves the trash
The page is back in the sidebar

cases.title: An archived page can be deleted permanently from the trash
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
The page is archived
expected: The page leaves the trash
The pages table no longer returns the page

cases.title: The page actions menu offers move up, move down, move and archive
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
expected: The menu shows Subir, Bajar, "Mover a…" and Archivar

cases.title: Searching for text that matches nothing says so
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
steps: Click "Buscar" and type a text no page contains
expected: The dialog shows "Sin resultados"

cases.title: Search also finds a page by its body text
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
steps: Open the page and type a unique word in the body, wait for the save
expected: The results list contains a link to the page

cases.title: An archived page is not returned by search
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
The page is archived
steps: Click "Buscar" and type the page title
expected: The dialog shows "Sin resultados"

cases.title: The share dialog lists the people who got access with their permission
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
steps: Check the access list and the Compartir button
Type the guest email and click "Compartir"
expected: Before sharing: the button is disabled and the list says "Nadie todavía."
After sharing: one person is listed with the permission "Puede ver"

cases.title: The share dialog offers the three permissions for people and groups
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
steps: Read the options of both permission selectors
expected: Each selector offers "Puede ver", "Puede editar" and "Acceso total"

cases.title: A page shared with "Puede ver" appears for the guest as read-only
preconditions: Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
The page is shared with the guest as VIEWER
steps: Click the page in the sidebar
expected: The workspace heading is "Espacio de <username>"
The page shows "Solo lectura" and its title
There are no Compartir or Archivar buttons

cases.title: A page that was not shared is not visible to the guest
preconditions: Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
The page is not shared
expected: The page does not appear in the sidebar

cases.title: The guest sidebar has no new page, trash or groups entries
preconditions: Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
expected: The switcher shows the role "Invitado"
There is no "Nueva página", Papelera or Grupos
Miembros and Preferencias are available

cases.title: Only the owner can see the trash
preconditions: Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
expected: The message "Solo el propietario del espacio puede ver la papelera" is shown
No archived pages are listed

cases.title: The guest members page hides the directory and offers to leave the workspace
preconditions: Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
expected: The guest explanation is shown
"Salir del espacio de trabajo" is available (not clicked)
The add member form is absent

cases.title: The guest has no access to the groups directory
preconditions: Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
expected: "Como invitado no tenés acceso al directorio de grupos." is shown
The create group form is absent

cases.title: The guest profile lists the workspaces with the guest role
preconditions: Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
expected: The owner's workspace is listed with the role "Invitado"

cases.title: Preferences show appearance, editor options and the app version
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
expected: The theme group has three options
"Vista compacta" is available
"Editor con formato" is on
The application version is shown

cases.title: Choosing a theme selects its option
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
expected: "Oscuro" is selected and the document gets the dark class
"Sistema" is selected afterwards (default restored)

cases.title: The profile shows the name, the username and the workspaces with their role
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
expected: The name field is filled and "Guardar nombre" is disabled
The username is shown
The own workspace is listed as "Propietario"

cases.title: The members page lists the owner and the guest with a role selector for the guest
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
expected: The owner is listed as "Propietario"
The guest is listed with the role selector set to "Invitado"
The new member role offers Administrador, Miembro and Invitado

cases.title: The add member button stays disabled until an email is typed
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
expected: "Agregar" is disabled, then enabled with an email, then disabled again (nothing is added)

cases.title: The groups page lists the QA group and keeps create disabled without a name
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
The group "Equipo QA" exists
steps: Type a group name without submitting
expected: "Crear" is disabled while the name is empty and enabled after typing
"Equipo QA" is listed with the owner as member

cases.title: The workspace switcher lists the account workspaces and the create option
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
expected: The own workspace is listed as "Propietario"
"Crear espacio de trabajo" is available

cases.title: Anonymous requests cannot read pages
preconditions: No bearer token, only the public apikey
expected: The response status is 401

cases.title: A created page is returned with its title, workspace and no parent
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
expected: One row with the title, the workspace id, parent_id null and archived_at null

cases.title: The title can be updated with a PATCH
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
expected: The status is 200 and the page has the new title

cases.title: A direct DELETE on the table is not permitted
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
expected: The status is 403
The page still exists

cases.title: archive_page marks the page archived and hides it from search
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
expected: The page is found before archiving
archive_page answers 204 and archived_at is set
The page is not found afterwards

cases.title: delete_page_permanently removes an archived page
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
A page named qa-auto-<time> exists in the owner's default workspace (created through the API)
expected: The delete call succeeds
The page query returns no rows

cases.title: share_page grants the guest read access to that page only
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
Two pages exist, one will be shared
steps: As the guest, GET the page (not shared yet)
As the owner, POST rpc/share_page with the guest email and VIEWER
As the guest, GET both pages
expected: Before sharing the guest gets no rows
After sharing the guest gets the shared page only

cases.title: The guest cannot edit, archive or delete a page shared as viewer
preconditions: Signed in as the QA owner (default profile)
Signed in as the QA guest (guest profile)
The page is shared with the guest as VIEWER
steps: As the guest, PATCH the title
As the owner, GET the page
expected: The PATCH changes no row
Archive and delete answer 403
The title is unchanged
